about_the_game:
Vaulted Valor is a single-player first-person mystery set in a post-apocalyptic underground vault.

You're trapped inside Vault E-9, a supposed sanctuary built to outlast the Great Cataclysm. You entered by choice, but the walls that were meant to protect you now feel more like a cage.

Rumors of people vanishing and whispers of sabotage circulate through the dark corridors, all pointing to one man: the vault's elusive president, Sylas. Explore the labyrinthine sectors, navigate tense relationships with your fellow survivors, and dig into a web of hidden agendas. In this place, every conversation and choice matters.

The truth is waiting, but how deep are you willing to go?

Key Features:

A gripping narrative mystery – Uncover conspiracies, betrayals, and the fate of the missing residents.

Choice-driven dialogue – Influence relationships and story outcomes through branching conversations.

Atmospheric world-building – Explore distinct sectors: sanitation, engineering, hydroponics, and more, each with unique NPCs

Multiple outcomes – Your actions determine who survives, who disappears, and what legacy Vault E-9 leaves behind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: You are in a post-apocalyptic underground vault where every decision carries weight. As you embark on quests and unravel a deep, twisting story, your actions will permanently alter the lives of your fellow inhabitants.
